title: status-flow: move Closed into terminalStatuses once a tolerant lore is the floor (A later, after QCLI-331's B)
description:
The "A later" half of opum-agent's 2026-09-28 re-ruling on QCLI-331 ("B NOW, A LATER"). It supersedes that session's earlier ruling for A. opum-doc records it as an amendment to ADR add-a-second-terminal-task-status-for-duplicate-superseded-and-wont-do-outcomes. The amendment's Consequences: consumers read terminalStatuses plus closedStatus until the floor moves.

NOW (QCLI-331, shape B): `quest task status-flow` gains closedStatus "Closed" and resolutions, and terminalStatuses stays ["Done"]. Quest's own readers treat Closed as terminal. As a result terminalStatuses UNDER-REPORTS: a consumer reading only terminalStatuses does not see Closed as terminal. That is the miss the ADR's Consequences names, and this task removes it.

WHY IT IS DEFERRED, measured at lore-cli 640195ec and confirmed by opum-agent: lore's quest adapter throws drift ("terminal statuses outside its status flow", src/adapters/quest.ts:676-681) when terminalStatuses is not a subset of statuses. The throw runs inside probe() (:405), and ensure() awaits probe() before every adapter operation. The same code is in v0.11.0. Moving Closed into terminalStatuses today therefore breaks every tracker-touching command of every published lore, for any workspace that upgrades quest alone. lore's MIN_QUEST_VERSION floor (0.2.7) does not prevent that pairing. opum-cli-e2e suites/21-quest-records.mjs:37-39 (5988da75) asserts the same subset.

BLOCKED ON, both external and not expressible as a quest dependency:
(1) lore-cli LCLI-633. It must accept terminal statuses as a subset of statuses plus closedStatus, and classify closedStatus as terminal in reconcile. It must also have become the lore adapter floor that consumers actually run, not merely be published.
(2) opum-cli-e2e's suite-21 subset row, relaxed the same way.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Before any change, both blockers are verified by ref and cited on this task: lore-cli LCLI-633 is Done and a lore release carrying it is the adapter floor consumers run, and opum-cli-e2e suite-21 no longer asserts terminalStatuses as a subset of statuses
quest task status-flow --json reports terminalStatuses including the closedStatus value, statuses stays the ladder, and closedStatus remains its own key
A lore at the tolerant floor runs a tracker-touching command (e.g. lore tasks) against the changed quest and exits 0, and a Closed task rolls up as terminal; measured, not inferred

The CHANGELOG entry and the task-finalization guide stop saying consumers must read closedStatus alongside terminalStatuses, and the opum-doc ADR amendment is updated or superseded by the orchestrator

implementationNotes: The ruling this task defers is recorded in opum-doc as ODOC-315, an amendment to ADR add-a-second-terminal-task-status-for-duplicate-superseded-and-wont-do-outcomes ("Amendment: rollout shape"), read by ref at opum-doc main == dev == d6516c5. SMALL ADJACENT FOLLOW-UP from QCLI-331: the manifest does not advertise the new data keys. task status-flow does not list closedStatus/resolutions, and task view does not list resolution. The reason is that quest's own tracker adapter probe (src/contract/tracker/index.ts) matches advertised field lists exactly. lore-cli does not: at 640195ec, REQUIRED_COMMANDS checks name, kind and mutating only, and has no `fields` read. Advertising them needs only quest's own probe, fixture and contract test updated. It can ride with this task or be filed separately.

SECOND BLOCKER IN opum-cli-e2e, reported by them and verified here by ref at opum-cli-e2e origin/dev 7d78b9a9. suites/60-project-lifecycle.mjs:142 pins terminalStatuses EXACTLY: `check.lockedPath(flow, "terminalStatuses", (v) => JSON.stringify(v) === JSON.stringify([DONE]))`, with expected text at :135. This task's description and AC1 name only suite 21's subset row (suites/21-quest-records.mjs:37-39). Suite 60's exact-equality pin ALSO goes red the moment Closed joins terminalStatuses, so it is an equal blocker: both rows must be relaxed before this task changes anything. opum-cli-e2e tracks their side as TASK-130, which is filed and blocked on this task. Under shape B, both rows pass on cfc5806: e2e measured suite 21 at 49/49 and suite 60 at 21/21.
